title: 2018 AMC 8 Problem 1
statement: An amusement park has a collection of scale models, with a ratio of \( 1: 20,\) of buildings and other sights from around the country. The height of the United States Capitol is \(289\) feet. What is the height in feet of its replica at this park, rounded to the nearest whole number?

solutions.text:
The replica is \(\dfrac{289}{20}=14.45\) feet tall, which rounds to \(14\) feet.

Thus, the correct answer is A.
hints: A \(1:20\) scale means the replica height is the real height divided by \(20\).
After dividing \(289\) by \(20\), round to the nearest whole foot.
